scoring_rules.relevance: 3 core job, 2 a feature the app has, 1 the category in general, 0 dropped
scoring_rules.winnability: 3 when you already rank 1 to 10 or the top 10's median size is at most 2x yours; 2 up to 10x; 1 above. Outside the top 10, minus 1 (floor 1) when 6+ of the top 10 are direct rivals or their median rating is 0.3 or more above yours
scoring_rules.demand: +1 for the top third of checked terms by the store's demand signal
scoring_rules.score: relevance x winnability + demand; 6+ primary, 4 to 5 secondary, below 4 park
scoring_rules.size: App Store: ratings count. Google Play: the installs band floor (search returns no ratings count)
scoring_rules.medians: the top 10's median rating and size are taken over the rival apps only; when you rank in the top 10, your own row is left out (9 apps)

google_play.title: Example Habits: Streak Tracker
google_play.short_description: Daily habits, a morning routine planner and a habit calendar that keeps streaks
google_play.full_description:
Example Habits is a habit tracker for the daily habits you want to keep. Check in once a day, watch your streaks grow, and see how each week went on the weekly chart.

ONE TAP A DAY
Add a habit, choose the days it runs and check it off when it is done. A check-in is a single tap, so keeping up with your daily habits fits into the small gaps in your day.

A STREAK FOR EVERY HABIT
Each habit keeps its own streak. The streak tracker counts the days in a row you have checked in, so you can tell at a glance which habits are holding and which need attention.

A ROUTINE PLANNER WITH REMINDERS
Group habits into routines: a morning routine before work, a wind down before bed, a set of steps for the weekend. The routine planner keeps each routine's habits together, and a reminder tells you when it is time to start. A morning routine of three habits becomes one reminder and three quick check-ins.

GOALS YOU CAN SEE
Give a habit a goal, such as five days a week. The goal tracker shows how close you are, and the weekly chart lays out every habit's week side by side, so a slipping goal is easy to spot before the week is over.

YOUR MONTH AT A GLANCE
The habit calendar marks every day you checked in. A whole month of check-ins sits on one screen, so you can look back and see which weeks your routines held and which ones slipped.

A CHART FOR EVERY WEEK
The weekly chart puts each habit on its own row and shows the days you checked in and the days you missed. It makes it plain which habits are settling in and which could use a smaller start, so a quick look on Sunday evening is enough to plan the week ahead.

TWO OPTIONAL ADD-ONS
Both stay off until you switch them on. The mood tracker adds a short mood note to a check-in, so your notes sit next to your habits. The water count lets you log glasses of water through the day, and you can give it a water reminder of its own.

HOW PEOPLE USE IT
A student keeps a morning routine for revision and a streak for going to bed on time. A parent checks off the school run routine and a daily walk. A runner sets a goal of four runs a week and watches the goal tracker fill up. Whatever the habit, the check-in takes seconds and the weekly chart shows how the week went.

Example Habits keeps it simple: a habit tracker, a streak tracker and a routine planner in one place, with goals and a habit calendar alongside. Pick one habit to start, give it a reminder, and add the next one when the first has stuck for a couple of weeks.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@example-habits.example.
